turns.user: Diễn viên và nhân vật thủ vai trong the Odyssey
turns.assistant_text:
"The Odyssey" is an ancient Greek epic poem attributed to Homer, and it features a variety of characters. Here are some notable ones:

1. **Odysseus** - The protagonist of the Odyssey, a Greek hero of the Trojan War who is trying to return home to Ithaca.

2. **Penelope** - The faithful wife of Odysseus who waits for his return.

3. **Telemachus** - The son of Odysseus and Penelope, who grows into a man during his father's absence.

4. **Athena** - The goddess of wisdom who assists Odysseus and Telemachus.

5. **Poseidon** - The god of the sea who is Odysseus's antagonist, making his journey home difficult.

6. **Calypso** - A nymph who keeps Odysseus on her island for several years.

7. **Circe** - A witch who initially turns Odysseus's men into swine but later becomes his ally.

8. **Polyphemus** - A Cyclops and son of Poseidon, who is blinded by Odysseus.

For a more comprehensive list of characters, you can refer to the [List of Homeric characters](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Homeric_characters) on Wikipedia.

items.title: Melantho (Odyssey)
items.summary: In Greek mythology, Melantho ( ; Ancient Greek: Μελανθώ, romanized: Melanthṓ) is one of the minor characters in the Odyssey.

items.title: Demodocus (Odyssey character)
items.summary: In the Odyssey by Homer, Demodocus (; Ancient Greek: Δημόδοκος, romanized: Dēmódokos) is a poet who often visits the court of Alcinous, king of the Phaeacians on the island of Phaeacia (also called Scheria). During Odysseus' stay on Scherie, Demodocus performs three narrative songs.

items.title: List of Homeric characters
items.summary: This is a list of principal characters in Homer's Iliad and Odyssey.
